title: Tautology belongs to coNP
statement: The language of bit strings whose decoded DNF formula evaluates to true under every Boolean assignment belongs to coNP; equivalently, its complement belongs to NP.
replaced:
The language $\mathrm{TAUTOLOGY}$, of binary strings whose decoded DNF formula is true
under every assignment, belongs to coNP; that is, its complement is in
$\mathrm{NP}$ [AB09, Section~2.6.1].
